'''Sevik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who, along with several other members of his [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew, worked to dupe two [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] into helping them find the treasure of [[Zelosian's Chine]]. He and [[Hanugar]] were shipwrecked when their vessel ran into one of [[Zelos II]]'s many coral reefs, where he and Hanugar were forced to fight off [[melk]] and wait for co-conspirator [[K'zk]]. After finding the treasure, the ship crew left the Weequays for dead, only to have the Weequays swear that they would hunt them down.<ref name="AJ13" />
